overview: The Medford City Council met remotely to consider a small business personal property tax exemption, zoning ordinance amendments, reopening guidelines for municipal employees and local businesses, traffic safety on South Street, and CPA funding appropriations.

items.title: Memorial Day Commemoration
items.summary: Veterans Services Director Mike Durham presented remarks on Memorial Day, and the Council voted to dedicate the meeting to the 8,000 veterans buried at Oak Grove Cemetery.

items.title: Resolution 20-371: Anniversary Congratulatory Resolution
items.summary: The Council voted to table a resolution congratulating Dorothy and Frank Zizzo on their 40th wedding anniversary.

items.title: Resolution 20-372: National Public Works Week Recognition
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution recognizing the Medford Department of Public Works in celebration of National Public Works Week.

items.title: Resolution 20-373: 90th Birthday Congratulatory Resolution
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution congratulating Mae Mockerbeck on the celebration of her 90th birthday.

items.title: Resolution 20-374: South Street and Main Street Traffic Safety Concerns
items.summary: The Council discussed public safety concerns at Main and South Streets, approving an amended motion requesting engineering reports, traffic-calming measures, a roundtable with state officials, and a Committee of the Whole meeting.

items.title: Resolution 20-375: Housing Assistance Programs Update
items.summary: Representatives from the Community Preservation Committee updated the Council on the emergency rental assistance program, and the Council passed an amended motion requesting written reports on future updates.

items.title: Paper 20-379: CPA Funding for David Osgood House Restoration
items.summary: The Council approved a $30,000 CPA General Reserve appropriation for the David Osgood House historic window restoration and ADA accessibility project.

items.title: Resolution 20-376: Public Employee Safety Reopening Update
items.summary: Chief of Staff Dave Rodrigues detailed Phase 1 municipal building reopening procedures and employee safety measures, and the resolution passed.

items.title: Resolution 20-377: Local Business Guidance Reopening Update
items.summary: Chief of Staff Dave Rodrigues reported on business information sessions and attestation checklists for reopening local businesses, and the resolution passed.

items.title: Resolution 20-378: Medford Public Library Construction Update Request
items.summary: The Council passed a resolution requesting a written update on design and material changes for the new Medford Public Library prior to an upcoming committee meeting.

items.title: Paper 20-380: Small Business Personal Property Tax Exemption
items.summary: The Council voted to accept M.G.L. Chapter 59, Section 5, Clause 54 to exempt up to $10,000 of fair cash value on personal property accounts beginning in FY2021.

items.title: Paper 20-381: Zoning Ordinance Amendment on Mixed-Use Multi-Family Development
items.summary: The Council voted to refer a proposed zoning amendment requiring 25% non-residential floor area in certain multi-family developments to the Community Development Board.

items.title: Committee Report: May 20, 2020 Committee of the Whole on Cannabis Ordinance
items.summary: The Council adopted a Committee of the Whole report regarding the draft adult-use marijuana ordinance.

items.title: Approval of Meeting Records
items.summary: The Council voted to approve the meeting records of May 19, 2020.
